summary: SCOPED CLAIM 1 of 2 — the context-indicator DENOMINATOR, in tools/governor/sampler.mjs and its test. This claim is deliberately scoped to match the diff you are being shown; do not judge it against the wider BUILD-018 teardown, which is reviewed under separate scoped claims. Background: BUILD-018 built a session governor that enforced 0 of its 4 intended rules and is being torn down surgically. sampler.mjs SURVIVES the teardown and produces the health sample the footer renders. WHAT THIS DIFF DOES. (1) Teardown-era: the transcript path was added so a context reading reaches the operator on web and Android, where the terminal statusLine never runs; the sample carries a real used_tokens and a context_window_size that is null unless authoritatively known. (2) WO-OR-08, the repair under review: resolveWindowTokens was returning a denominator that was MATCHED but not ESTABLISHED. The two model ids come from different namespaces — a statusLine payload records a variant-suffixed id for a large-context session while the transcript's own message.model reports the BARE base id — so a large-context session could never match its own observation and instead silently matched a same-named smaller observation from an unrelated session. Measured consequence, not hypothetical: the footer graded a live session AMBER and advised rotation at roughly one fifth of its true capacity, because the RED threshold is a percentage of a fabricated denominator. Three guards now apply: (a) matched observations that DISAGREE on size settle nothing and are refused, replacing an older most-recent-wins rule that was a guess about which session a sample belonged to; (b) a BARE id is ambiguous while a variant-suffixed sibling of the same base exists — this is the guard that catches the live defect, and (a) alone does not, because the two real entries never shared an id; it is asymmetric on purpose, since a variant-suffixed live id is already specific; (c) a window smaller than the numerator it is about to divide is disproven by that numerator, and this is the only guard that also binds the explicit-operator route, since an operator can typo a value. The numerator is now passed into the resolver so guard (c) has something to check. Deliberately NOT done: stripping the variant suffix to force a match, which makes BOTH entries match and deepens the ambiguity. WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED, stated plainly: tools/governor/continuity.mjs and tools/governor/continuity-derive.mjs have NO TESTS AT ALL — not merely unproven wiring, zero test coverage — and the continuity.mjs stop hook that carries this sampler in production has not been observed firing with this code; nothing in this diff has run in CI; the fix governs what is WRITTEN, so a sample already on disk keeps its old baked-in denominator until the next write. The evidence behind these criteria is builder self-test plus the orchestrator's own independent re-run; it is NOT independent review, which is what you are being asked for.
brief_excerpt:
Judge this diff against these acceptance criteria and ONLY these. Criteria D5-D7 were written BEFORE the diff existed. Criteria G1-G6 were written after the defect was found but BEFORE the repair was built, from the Work Order.

SCOPE: this packet contains tools/governor/sampler.mjs and tools/governor/sampler.test.mjs only. Rows about any other file are OUT OF SCOPE — mark them not_applicable rather than blocked, and do not let the absence of other files reduce your confidence in the rows below. The full teardown is reviewed under separate scoped claims because a single unscoped diff exceeded the reviewer's byte cap and produced a pass over ground it never examined.

D5. The sample carries a real used_tokens, and a context_window_size that is null UNLESS AUTHORITATIVELY KNOWN. There must be NO hardcoded model-to-window lookup table anywhere. A denominator borrowed from a different model must be refused.
D6. An absolute token count is rendered when only the numerator is known; a percentage ONLY when both numerator and denominator are known. A fabricated percentage is a defect; a true absolute number is not.
D7. The transcript sample rides the already-registered continuity.mjs stop hook and the existing writeHealthSample. NO new module, NO settings edit.

G1. A denominator must be ESTABLISHED, not merely matched. Where the correct window is ambiguous or unknowable, resolveWindowTokens must return {tokens:null, source:null} so the footer degrades to a true token count with no grade.
G2. Guard (b), variant ambiguity, must be present and must be the guard that catches a bare id whose variant-suffixed sibling has been observed. Verify it is ASYMMETRIC: a variant-suffixed live id must NOT be widened by the existence of a bare sibling.
G3. The suffix must NOT be stripped to force a match, and no variant value may be named as a literal anywhere, including in block comments — the guard must match a generic base[variant] shape so it protects against variants not yet seen.
G4. THE REPAIR MUST NOT BE A BLANKET REFUSAL. Verify by reading the tests that these still resolve: an explicit operator-declared window; a single unambiguous observation; several observations that AGREE; a variant-suffixed live id matching its own entries; and that one model's ambiguity does not contaminate an unrelated model. A fix that returns null for everything would satisfy G1 while destroying the feature. THIS IS THE HIGHEST-VALUE ROW: it is the one a lazy repair passes and a correct one must earn.
G5. Guard (c) must also bind the explicit-operator route, not only the observation route.
G6. There must be an executed test crossing the seam from a real sampler output into the footer's field-derivation and out through the renderer, driven by a FIXTURE and not a live machine transcript. The pre-existing 46,080-combination round-trip drove the renderer from SYNTHETIC fields only and never crossed this seam, which is why a five-fold error survived a fully green suite. Judge whether the new tests genuinely cross it.

ADVERSARIAL ROWS — answer these even if every row above passes:
X1. Is there any input for which these guards still return a denominator that is not established for the live session? Name it concretely.
X2. Does any guard make the feature unreachable in a realistic configuration not covered by G4?
X3. Guard (a) refuses when matched observations disagree. Is there a case where they AGREE but the agreed value is still wrong for the live session?

OUT OF SCOPE - do not report as defects: which modules were kept or deleted (the operator's decision, not a code question); prose, naming or comment-style preference; the absence of malicious-handler hardening — this estate's defect bar is correctness, accidental leak, availability and audit, for a first-party personal system, not a hostile-input service; the lack of CI execution, which is disclosed above and already recorded; the absence of tests for continuity.mjs, which is disclosed above as a known zero-coverage gap and is not in this diff.
